name: L-arginine
description: Amino acid found in food; the body uses it to make nitric oxide

status.usStatus: Dietary supplement; not FDA approved for ED

note.text: Trials were mostly 30 to 100 men. Several in the pooled analysis combined arginine with other substances.

bullets: **Used by the body** to make nitric oxide, which relaxes blood vessels
**Erection effects** reported in rat and rabbit studies (animal)
**Penile blood flow:** unchanged in a 1999 trial, higher in a 2022 trial
No Phase III trial for ED

practical.routes: By mouth in ED trials; vein (R-Gene 10 test)
practical.soldAs: Dietary supplement; Rx injection only as R-Gene 10
practical.monitored: Erection scores, penile blood flow, nitric oxide markers

regulatory.text: Not approved for ED; R-Gene 10 test only

references: Rhim et al., J Sex Med, arginine for ED meta-analysis, Feb 2019
Menafra et al., J Endocrinol Invest, L-arginine in vascular ED, Jan 2022
